record.question: This country became the world's first country to grant citizenship to a robot.
record.explanation: Answer A: Saudi Arabia. The event organizer’s executive report, page 64, records Sophia receiving Saudi Arabian citizenship in 2017 as the first robot to do so. Historical/source note: This records the event’s citizenship announcement, not a legal opinion that all ordinary citizenship rights were enforceable for a robot. Reference: https://fii-institute.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/FR2303_ExecutiveReport_Digital_XS-1-1.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
